question: In Chapter 322, "Puffing Tom", Zoro calls Sanji "Darts". Why "Darts"? Eyelashes
answer: Was it too tough to figure out? I had several people ask this question. I don't think he was referring to the darts themselves, but the dartboard. Because it's all swirly. Geez! Stupid Zoro! Make a bit more sense, would you?!
name: Lovely Eyelashes
